rules.question: Which charts does the library list, in what order, with what copies and naming copy?
rules.owner: ChartIndex::from_rows in src/store/chart_index.cpp, fed by RecordStore::chart_index's one scan-order read
must_match: Stmt s = prepare_read(db_, "SELECT md5, name FROM charts ORDER BY rowid");
must_not_match: db_, (library_entry_select() + " ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?").c_str());

owner_lines.line_text: Stmt s = prepare_read(db_, (library_entry_select() + " ORDER BY rowid").c_str());
owner_lines.why: RecordStore::chart_index, the one scan-order read that feeds the owner

rules.note: The library's rows in scan order are what decide which copy names a chart and how many copies it has. A second scan-order read of the charts table would be a second place working those answers out; it reads chart_index() instead. Decided by: D115 (spec section 8)
